probe: P0 bucket ledger / r-loss scorer / fit-heldout split
bed_bytes_note: This probe does NOT open the bed; the size is recorded for provenance only. The basis ladder receipt recorded bed_bytes=24570433536 on 2026-08-28.
bed_access: none -- receipts and JSON maps only
kill_criterion: KILL (ledger untrustworthy) if EITHER (a) the deterministically recomputed bucket counts disagree with the published wave-2 taxonomy counts (pool_absent 109 / near_band 41 / delivery_side 6; semantic 61/20/1; basic 37/18/5) on any cell, OR (b) the 156 mined misses are not exactly the 156 needles with delivered_gold==0 in the basis ladder receipt, OR (c) the recomputed chunk_split count is not 65/156. INCONCLUSIVE if a required field is missing from the inputs. Otherwise PASS. Note this criterion grades the LEDGER's fidelity, not whether chunk_split is a promising lane -- the coverage arithmetic in section 3 is reported as-measured either way.
verdict_reason: All 156 mined misses are exactly the basis receipt's delivered_gold==0 set; recomputed buckets match every published taxonomy cell; chunk_split recomputes to 65/156 as published; rloss self-test passes identity, negative and shuffle controls.

bucket_definitions.pool_absent: live_rank is null (gold absent from the published score map) OR live_rank > 100
bucket_definitions.seat_capped: live_rank <= 12 while delivered_gold == 0 (gold made the pool top-12 but was not shipped)
bucket_definitions.note: On this mine the three are exhaustive and mutually exclusive; every miss has delivered_gold==0 by construction, so seat_capped needs no extra clause in practice.

chunk_split_definition: gold_kw_cov (UNION coverage over all gold chunks) >= delivered[0].kw_cov AND gold_first.kw_cov < delivered[0].kw_cov -- the gold DOCUMENT would tie or beat the rank-1 winner on distinct query-term coverage, but gold's best single CHUNK does not.

section_3_overlap.definition_note: Buckets are mutually exclusive by construction (one per miss). chunk_split is an ORTHOGONAL flag, so the 156 misses carry 1 bucket + 0-or-1 chunk_split. The 'flags' histogram counts membership in one of the three headline taxonomy categories (sem_pool_absent / basic_pool_absent / near_band) plus chunk_split, which is the 139 + 65 = 204 arithmetic.

arithmetic.overlap_explained_by: chunk_split is not a fourth bucket: 57 of its 65 members already sit inside one of the three headline categories, and the residual 8 sit in the 17 misses outside them.

reachable_population.definition: 156 misses minus the 61 semantic pool-absent misses -- the population a rollup lane is allowed to be judged on, since the semantic crater is already a standing KILL for pool-recovery lanes on this bed.

carry_arithmetic.reading: A single doc-rollup lane that converted EVERY chunk_split miss at 100% yield would supply 39 of the 62 needles needed (62.9%) if it is confined to the reachable population, or 65 (104.8%) if it is also allowed to fire inside the semantic crater. A perfect lane is not a real yield, so treat these as hard ceilings: chunk_split alone cannot carry +62, but it is the largest single mechanism on the board.

section_4_fit_heldout_split.method: stratified by (question_type x baseline delivered-gold hit/miss); names sorted inside each stratum, then shuffled with random.Random(20260901); strata visited in sorted key order; odd leftovers alternate between fit and held-out so the halves stay balanced. Fully reproducible from this receipt.

negative_control.note: one hit flipped to miss, one miss flipped to hit; RI is 0 but churn is 2

shuffle_control.note: arm rows shuffled; churn stays 0, proving pairing is by needle name
